rules.statement: The court's decision does not require the valuer to consider any decrease in value due to the use to which the land will be put after its acquisition.
rules.supporting_quote: "The purport of provision of sub section C of section 48 is to exclude any 'increase' likely to occur after acquisition' and only provide that such increase 'shall not be taken into 'consideration'. Even on a plain reading of the section it is clear that the provisions ' do not require to take into account any decrease in value '."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 48(e) of the Land Acquisition Act
